intendedObjective: Check the guide for process misunderstandings.
acceptableEditScope: Change only wording that could cause an employee to misunderstand the process.
stableFactsAndClaims: Corrections require shift date, recorded and proposed times, and a reason; each submission covers three shifts.
Requests do not immediately alter timecards; supervisors compare shift records and contact employees about differences.
Status appears beside the original timecard; original and proposed entries remain visible until review finishes.
Missing shifts use Add a shift, not Correct a shift.
Rejected worked dates and error messages go to scheduling; inaccurate substitute dates must not be submitted.
voiceConstraints: Direct procedural guidance with clear precautions.

sourceObjectiveEvidence.quote: Check this internal guide for ease of use.
Make changes only where an employee could otherwise misunderstand the process.
Use the correction form when a submitted timecard contains an error.
